description:
Check a domain's TLS-RPT record (_smtp._tls.<domain> TXT). TLS-RPT lets you receive reports about TLS delivery failures to your domain.

Args:
  - domain (string): the domain to check.
  - response_format ('markdown' | 'json'): output format (default 'markdown').

Returns: { found, record, findings[] }.

Example: "Does microsoft.com publish TLS-RPT?" -> tls_rpt_check(domain="microsoft.com").

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for a human-readable summary (default) or 'json' for the full structured payload.

name: tls_rpt_check
title: TLS-RPT Check
